data.current_summary: Check whether a long trade clears after all costs (1 credit on success)
data.summary_suggestion: Validate long trade economics after fees and slippage
data.description_suggestion: Deterministic pre-trade economics check for long (buy) positions. Validates whether a proposed trade clears after accounting for exchange fees, bid-ask spread, slippage, and an optional profit buffer. Requires authentication via Bearer token. Input: entry price, exit price, position size, fees, spread, slippage, and optional profit buffer. Output: boolean pass/fail result with detailed cost breakdown and net profit calculation. Side effects: Consumes 1 prepaid credit on successful check (0 credits on failure). Same model_version and input always produce identical output. No market data, predictions, or trade execution performed.
